subject: Kickoff: ARDMs for budget-adaptive generation and compression
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off the ARDM workstream under the efficiency portfolio. Two properties from our open-source release make this a product, not just a paper: ARDMs generate variables in any order and support parallel generation that adapts to a given step budget, and they reach the same test performance as discrete diffusion with significantly fewer steps. That's a direct serving-cost lever.

Target outcomes by 5/18: (1) a compression pilot - ARDM-based lossless compression on one internal audio corpus, benchmarked against our current bits-back-free baseline; (2) a generation-latency study showing quality vs. network-call budget curves for text and images.

Milestones: training infra ready end of Feb, first compression numbers by end of March, launch review early May.

Alina owns staffing and the data-readiness plan.

Zofia
